verses.text: A Miktam of David. Preserve me, O God, for I take refuge in You.

segments.text: A Miktam of David. Preserve me, O God, for I take refuge in You.

verses.text: I said to YHWH, “You [are] my Lord. My goodness [is] nothing apart from You.”

segments.text: I said to YHWH, “You [are] my Lord. My goodness [is] nothing apart from You.”

verses.text: As for the holy ones who [are] in the land, they and the excellent ones, all my delight [is] in them.

segments.text: As for the holy ones who [are] in the land, they and the excellent ones, all my delight [is] in them.

verses.text: May their sorrows be multiplied, those who hurry [after] another! I will not pour out their drink offerings of blood, and I will not lift up their names upon my lips.

segments.text: May their sorrows be multiplied, those who hurry [after] another! I will not pour out their drink offerings of blood, and I will not lift up their names upon my lips.

verses.text: YHWH, [is] the portion of my share, and my cup; You [are] the One upholding my lot.

segments.text: YHWH, [is] the portion of my share, and my cup; You [are] the One upholding my lot.

verses.text: The lines have fallen to me in the pleasant [places]; indeed, a pleasing inheritance [is] unto me.

segments.text: The lines have fallen to me in the pleasant [places]; indeed, a pleasing inheritance [is] unto me.

verses.text: I will bless YHWH, who counsels me; even [in] the nights, my kidneys instruct me.

segments.text: I will bless YHWH, who counsels me; even [in] the nights, my kidneys instruct me.

verses.text: I have set YHWH before me continually; because [He is] at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

segments.text: I have set YHWH before me continually; because [He is] at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

verses.text: Therefore my heart is glad and my glory rejoices; my flesh also will dwell securely.

segments.text: Therefore my heart is glad and my glory rejoices; my flesh also will dwell securely.

verses.text: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, and You will not give Your Holy one to see corruption.

segments.text: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, and You will not give Your Holy one to see corruption.

verses.text: You make known to me the path of life; fullness of joys [is] with Your face, pleasant [things] [are] at Your right hand forever.

segments.text: You make known to me the path of life; fullness of joys [is] with Your face, pleasant [things] [are] at Your right hand forever.
